reasoning: The three DTO integer fields are validated nonnegative and bounded before comparison. The16KiB input cap bounds all digit/string work.

For nonzero values, equal significant decimal digits plus equal trailing-zero/decimal-exponent displacement are necessary and sufficient for exact equality. No binary-float result is used by the comparison.

The required shift is bounded by input length; parsing the exponent as int64 rejects exponents unable to equal that bounded shift without allocating a power-of-ten integer. All-zero tokens retain signed-zero and arbitrary exponent compatibility.

JCS still validates complete JSON syntax and exact duplicate names. The final canonical schema reconstruction still rejects case-alias/unknown/missing-schema variations. Failure returns an empty Document.

The actual11 rejected fractional/underflow cases and18 previously valid controls exercise positive/revision bounds, decimal/exponent forms and zero. Original certificate/signature code, dependencies and all original tests are unchanged.
